findings.message: The left join to payments can create multiple rows per order because payments may contain several rows per order_id, breaking the orders model's unique order_id constraint.
evidence: orders model declares a unique test on order_id (order_id unique, not_null).
stg_payments (source for payments) does NOT have a unique test on order_id.
findings.suggestion: Aggregate payments by order_id before joining or join on a column that is unique in the payments side.
